mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ai_search_usage (member_id, usage_date, request_count, input_tokens, output_tokens, updated_at) VALUES (#{memberId}, #{date}, 0, 0, 0, #{now}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE member_id = member_id
mapper.select: SELECT CAST(COALESCE(SUM(input_tokens), 0) AS SIGNED) AS inputTokens, CAST(COALESCE(SUM(output_tokens), 0) AS SIGNED) AS outputTokens FROM ai_search_usage WHERE usage_date = #{date}
